name: oauth-consent-nextjs
title: OAuth Consent for Next.js
description: OAuth 2.1 consent screen and route for an existing authenticated application.
docs:
After installation, set the following in `supabase/config.toml`. Recent CLI versions already write an `[auth.oauth_server]` section with `enabled = false` — edit that section rather than adding a second one:

```toml
[auth.oauth_server]
enabled = true
authorization_url_path = "/oauth/consent"
```
